spans.text: [1] AR: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَهُ ٱلْحَمْدُ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ EN: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and to Him belongs [all] praise in the Hereafter.

folded.subject: And We
folded.object: between them and the cities which We had blessed [many] visible cities

spans.text: [18] AR: وَجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْقُرَى ٱلَّتِى بَٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا قُرًۭى ظَٰهِرَةًۭ وَقَدَّرْنَا فِيهَا ٱلسَّيْرَ ۖ سِيرُوا۟ فِيهَا لَيَالِىَ وَأَيَّامًا ءَامِنِينَ EN: And We placed between them and the cities which We had blessed [many] visible cities.

folded.id: and we|replaced|their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit
folded.subject: and We
folded.object: their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit

spans.text: [16] AR: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ EN: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees.

folded.id: at what|is|before them and what is behind them of the heaven and earth?
folded.subject: at what
folded.object: before them and what is behind them of the heaven and earth?

spans.text: [9] AR: أَفَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِن نَّشَأْ نَخْسِفْ بِهِمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ أَوْ نُسْقِطْ عَلَيْهِمْ كِسَفًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ لِّكُلِّ عَبْدٍۢ مُّنِيبٍۢ EN: Then, do they not look at what is before them and what is behind them of the heaven and earth?

folded.id: belongs whatever|is|in the heavens and whatever is in the earth
folded.subject: belongs whatever
folded.object: in the heavens and whatever is in the earth

spans.text: [1] AR: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَهُ ٱلْحَمْدُ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ EN: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and to Him belongs [all] praise in the Hereafter.

folded.id: do we|repay|except the ungrateful?
folded.subject: do We
folded.object: except the ungrateful?

spans.text: And do We [thus] repay except the ungrateful?

folded.id: for them|will|be a painful punishment of foul nature
folded.subject: for them
folded.object: be a painful punishment of foul nature

spans.text: [5] AR: وَٱلَّذِينَ سَعَوْ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا مُعَٰجِزِينَ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ مِّن رِّجْزٍ أَلِيمٌۭ EN: But those who strive against Our verses [seeking] to cause failure - for them will be a painful punishment of foul nature.

folded.id: from him|is|an atom's weight within the heavens or within the earth or [what is] smaller than that or greater
folded.subject: from Him
folded.object: an atom's weight within the heavens or within the earth or [what is] smaller than that or greater

spans.text: Not absent from Him is an atom's weight within the heavens or within the earth or [what is] smaller than that or greater, except that it is in a clear register -

folded.id: if they|had|known the unseen
folded.subject: if they
folded.object: known the unseen

spans.text: But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment.

folded.id: if we|should|will
folded.subject: If We
folded.object: will

spans.text: If We should will, We could cause the earth to swallow them or [could] let fall upon them fragments from the sky.

folded.id: in that|is|a sign for every servant turning back [to allah]
folded.subject: in that
folded.object: a sign for every servant turning back [to Allah]

spans.text: Indeed in that is a sign for every servant turning back [to Allah].

folded.id: it|will|surely come to you
folded.subject: it
folded.object: surely come to you

spans.text: Say, "Yes, by my Lord, it will surely come to you.

folded.id: lie or|is|there in him madness?"
folded.subject: lie or
folded.object: there in him madness?"

spans.text: [8] AR: أَفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَم بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌۢ ۗ بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ وَٱلضَّلَٰلِ ٱلْبَعِيدِ EN: Has he invented about Allah a lie or is there in him madness?"

folded.id: man who|will|inform you [that] when you have disintegrated in complete disintegration
folded.subject: man who
folded.object: inform you [that] when you have disintegrated in complete disintegration

spans.text: [7] AR: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هَلْ نَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍۢ يُنَبِّئُكُمْ إِذَا مُزِّقْتُمْ كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍ إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى خَلْقٍۢ جَدِيدٍ EN: But those who disbelieve say, "Shall we direct you to a man who will inform you [that] when you have disintegrated in complete disintegration, you will [then] be [recreated] in a new creation?

folded.id: praise|is|[due] to allah
folded.subject: praise
folded.object: [due] to Allah

spans.text: [1] AR: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَهُ ٱلْحَمْدُ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ EN: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and to Him belongs [all] praise in the Hereafter.

folded.id: so we|made|them narrations and dispersed them in total dispersion
folded.subject: so We
folded.object: them narrations and dispersed them in total dispersion

spans.text: [19] AR: فَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا بَٰعِدْ بَيْنَ أَسْفَارِنَا وَظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ وَمَزَّقْنَٰهُمْ كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍۢ شَكُورٍۢ EN: But [insolently] they said, "Our Lord, lengthen the distance between our journeys," and wronged themselves, so We made them narrations and dispersed them in total dispersion.

folded.id: so we|sent|upon them the flood of the dam
folded.subject: so We
folded.object: upon them the flood of the dam

spans.text: [16] AR: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ EN: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees.

folded.id: that it|is|in a clear register -
folded.subject: that it
folded.object: in a clear register -

spans.text: Not absent from Him is an atom's weight within the heavens or within the earth or [what is] smaller than that or greater, except that it is in a clear register -

folded.id: that we|repaid|them because they disbelieved
folded.subject: that We
folded.object: them because they disbelieved

spans.text: [17] AR: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَيْنَٰهُم بِمَا كَفَرُوا۟ ۖ وَهَلْ نُجَٰزِىٓ إِلَّا ٱلْكَفُورَ EN: [By] that We repaid them because they disbelieved.

folded.id: that what|is|revealed to you from your lord is the truth
folded.subject: that what
folded.object: revealed to you from your Lord is the truth

spans.text: [6] AR: وَيَرَى ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ هُوَ ٱلْحَقَّ وَيَهْدِىٓ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ EN: And those who have been given knowledge see that what is revealed to you from your Lord is the truth, and it guides to the path of the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy.

folded.id: the hereafter|will|be in the punishment and [are in] extreme error
folded.subject: the Hereafter
folded.object: be in the punishment and [are in] extreme error

spans.text: Rather, they who do not believe in the Hereafter will be in the punishment and [are in] extreme error.

folded.id: the hour|will|not come to us
folded.subject: The Hour
folded.object: not come to us

spans.text: [3] AR: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَا تَأْتِينَا ٱلسَّاعَةُ ۖ قُلْ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّى لَتَأْتِيَنَّكُمْ عَٰلِمِ ٱلْغَيْبِ ۖ لَا يَعْزُبُ عَنْهُ مِثْقَالُ ذَرَّةٍۢ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَآ أَصْغَرُ مِن ذَٰلِكَ وَلَآ أَكْبَرُ إِلَّا فِى كِتَٰبٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ EN: But those who disbelieve say, "The Hour will not come to us."

folded.id: they|made|for him what he willed of elevated chambers
folded.subject: They
folded.object: for him what he willed of elevated chambers

spans.text: [13] AR: يَعْمَلُونَ لَهُۥ مَا يَشَآءُ مِن مَّحَٰرِيبَ وَتَمَٰثِيلَ وَجِفَانٍۢ كَٱلْجَوَابِ وَقُدُورٍۢ رَّاسِيَٰتٍ ۚ ٱعْمَلُوٓا۟ ءَالَ دَاوُۥدَ شُكْرًۭا ۚ وَقَلِيلٌۭ مِّنْ عِبَادِىَ ٱلشَّكُورُ EN: They made for him what he willed of elevated chambers, statues, bowls like reservoirs, and stationary kettles.

folded.id: those|will|have forgiveness and noble provision
folded.subject: Those
folded.object: have forgiveness and noble provision

spans.text: Those will have forgiveness and noble provision.

folded.id: we|could|cause the earth to swallow them or [could] let fall upon them fragments from the sky
folded.subject: We
folded.object: cause the earth to swallow them or [could] let fall upon them fragments from the sky

spans.text: If We should will, We could cause the earth to swallow them or [could] let fall upon them fragments from the sky.

folded.id: we|will|make him taste of the punishment of the blaze
folded.subject: We
folded.object: make him taste of the punishment of the Blaze

spans.text: And whoever deviated among them from Our command - We will make him taste of the punishment of the Blaze.

folded.id: when we|decreed|for solomon death
folded.subject: when We
folded.object: for Solomon death

spans.text: [14] AR: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ EN: And when We decreed for Solomon death, nothing indicated to the jinn his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff.

folded.id: you|will|[then] be [recreated] in a new creation?
folded.subject: you
folded.object: [then] be [recreated] in a new creation?

spans.text: [7] AR: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هَلْ نَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍۢ يُنَبِّئُكُمْ إِذَا مُزِّقْتُمْ كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍ إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى خَلْقٍۢ جَدِيدٍ EN: But those who disbelieve say, "Shall we direct you to a man who will inform you [that] when you have disintegrated in complete disintegration, you will [then] be [recreated] in a new creation?
